intro: Following Denalan's botanical experiments at Lake Al'Ameth, the planted frond seeds take root and bloom. This quiet moment marks a successful harvest in understanding Teldrassil's strange and vital flora. Travelers inspecting the garden beds can witness the rapid growth firsthand.

paras: The fronds Denalan planted within his garden have sprouted and grown. They tremble, eager to be picked....
